text:
Amy Park: Heads-up — MedSecure just sent a hard requirement around audit logs and long-term retention. They want 7 years of immutable audit logs + exportable evidence for audits. Can we triage?
Will Gomez: Copy of customer note pasted: 
- Regulated healthcare provider (EHR integration)
- Requires SOC2/HIPAA evidence + 7yr retention for admin & security audit logs
- Must support key-managed encryption (customer KMS/HSM)
- Data residency: EU only for patient-related logs
Jay Singh: Ticket #34567 created and questionnaire attached: https://intranet.redwood/tickets/34567
Jay Singh: forwarding the completed questionnaire PDF from the customer in the ticket. Short summary inside.
Will Gomez: They said they'll convert to a Dedicated + Private deployment if these are supported. High commercial impact.
Olivia Martinez: Quick clarifying Qs: which event types do they mean by "audit logs"? Admin changes, auth events, dataset access, model inputs? Need to scope. Also: immutability -> append-only + WORM storage?
Tom Becker: Legal needs to know what "evidence" looks like for them. Typically SOC2 wants immutable log retention + retention policy + access controls + attestations. For HIPAA we need Audit Controls evidence and BAAs.
Li Chen: Feasibility notes: short-term we can provide exported logs to a customer-controlled S3 with lifecycle rules. Medium-term: per-tenant retention config + console UI + automated purge proofs. Effort estimate: export hook ~1 sprint, per-tenant retention + UI ~3 sprints, KMS/HSM integration depends on cloud provider but add config surface.
Li Chen: example of a minimal retention config we could expose (prototype):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "medsecure-123",
  "retention_days": 2555, // ~7 years
  "log_types": ["admin","auth","access"],
  "export_target": "s3://redwood-exports/medsecure/",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd-...",
  "immutability": true
}
```
Olivia Martinez: Immutability + proof: we'll need signed digests/time-stamped manifests and retention logs that show the retention window and purge actions (or lack thereof). Also need key usage logs to show KMS rotations didn't break access.
Will Gomez: Customer timeline: demo next week, contract decision in ~6 weeks. They need a clear list of must-haves vs. nice-to-haves.
Amy Park: Proposed prioritization for product backlog:
- MUST: exportable audit logs (admin/auth/access), per-tenant export target, 7-year retention supported via export + lifecycle, KMS key config for export, EU-region export endpoints.
- SHOULD: per-tenant retention UI, immutable/WORM-backed storage option, signed manifests for forensic proof.
- MAYBE: automated evidence bundle generator for SOC2/HIPAA audits, one-click export of evidence.
Amy Park: Launch criteria (suggested):
1) End-to-end test that simulates tenant export and verifies retention metadata + signed manifest.
2) Docs + runbook for sales + support.
3) KMS/HSM config flows validated in EU region.
4) Security review + POAM completed.
Jay Singh: Interim workaround: we can set up nightly exports to customer S3 (EU) and hand them the files for now. Low friction and can unblock sales.
Li Chen: Acceptance tests we should add to backlog:
- verify exported logs contain required event types
- simulate purge after retention period and verify manifests show no tampering
- verify tenant-scoped KMS access + rotation recovery
Olivia Martinez: Also include alerting for export failures and signed attestations for each export. Auditors will ask for chain-of-custody.
Tom Becker: I'll draft language for BAAs and evidence clauses once we have the technical approach. I'll need the exact log schemas and retention proof format.
compliance-bot: Checklist generated: [SOC2 evidence kit, HIPAA audit controls, EU residency enforcement, KMS config, export scheduler, signed-manifest system].
Amy Park: Action items:
- Will: confirm customer will accept nightly export as interim and capture commitment (due EOD tomorrow) @Will Gomez
- Jay: set up ticket playbook for export & onboarding steps for MedSecure (start today) @Jay Singh
- Li: spike for export hook + KMS config (2wk spike) and estimate full effort for per-tenant retention UI @Li Chen
- Olivia: draft security requirements for immutable export + signed-manifest proof, list dependencies @Olivia Martinez
- Tom: draft contract language for retention and evidence (BAA + audit clause) @Tom Becker
Amy Park: If everyone agrees, I'll add the must-have items as a P0 slice and schedule the spike. :thumbsup:
Will Gomez: Agree — interim export will buy us time. I'll push customer to accept Dedicated commitment sooner. :rocket:
Jay Singh: I'll attach the questionnaire to the ticket and ping support docs owners.
Li Chen: I'll post spike notes in #eng-runtime when started.
Olivia Martinez: tagging security review.
Tom Becker: noted.
Amy Park: Thanks team — I'll follow up with a short PRD and scoreboard for prioritization by EOD.
